title: Route aliases
description: Renamed routes (EE-032). Routes are an API that agents and scripts depend on, so a renamed record keeps its old route as an alias: the router follows it and answers with a deprecation note. Remove an alias only after the version it was deprecated in has been out for a release. interface/test.mjs checks that every alias points at a route that exists.
